summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' catalogue — wholly distinct from Periclymenus son of Neleus, the shape-shifting prince of Pylos slain when Heracles sacked the city.

story.text: Apollodorus names Periclymenus among the wooers who came from Zacynthus, listed after Alcarops and before Antenor in Epitome 7.29.
